read_ply_file: read a PLY file from disk using PlyData.read and access vertex or face element data
write_ply_file: write a PLY file to disk by creating a PlyData object with PlyElement elements and calling write
describe_ply_element: construct a PlyElement from a numpy structured array using PlyElement.describe for writing PLY data
parse_ply_header: parse a PLY file header from a stream using PlyData._parse_header to extract format and element metadata
make2d_array: convert an array of arrays into a 2D numpy array using make2d with specified cols and dtype
